title: Scarlet Basilica
wikitext:
[[Image:The Scarlet Basilica.jpg|thumb|The Scarlet Basilica]]
'''The Scarlet Basilica''' is a large cathedral located inside [[Tyr's Hand]] in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]]. It is the high seat of religious power for the [[Scarlet Crusade]], and has close ties to the [[Tyr's Hand Abbey]] nearby as well as the [[Scarlet Monastery]] much further west in [[Tirisfal Glades]]. It is the location of [[Crusader Lord Valdelmar]].

The Scarlet Basilica is built very much like the [[Cathedral of Light]] in the city of [[Stormwind]].
